description: The Peking University SHIFT research team publishes demonstration code for deriving geomorphic floodplain boundaries from terrain. The method uses MERIT-Hydro and floodplain hydraulic geometry, estimating spatially varying parameters before mapping floodplain extent. Its documented application is the static global SHIFT product at approximately 90 m resolution. Zenodo archives the source as a public ZIP under CC-BY-4.0, free to reuse with attribution; a linked GitHub README explains the scope of the code. The release contains terrain-attribute preparation and parameter estimation, but omits input preprocessing, spatial splitting or merging and several analysis steps. This limitation means it is not an immediately complete reproduction pipeline. The code could help examine floodplain-domain assumptions used before infrastructure flood-exposure simulations. It complements the finished SHIFT grids by exposing the principal estimation steps. Dependencies, execution and numerical agreement with the published map were not checked.
